slides.title: Spain 95, Australia 88
slides.body: Two overtimes in the World Cup semi-final. Still one of the great Australia–Spain games.

slides.title: 71–71 after 40 minutes
slides.body: Spain and Australia could not be separated in regulation or in the first overtime. It took a second overtime to decide the 2019 FIBA World Cup semi-final.

slides.title: Gasol 33. Mills 32.
slides.body: Marc Gasol scored 33 for Spain. Patty Mills answered with 32 for Australia. It was the first double-overtime game for either country at a World Cup.

slides.title: Spain went on to win it all
slides.body: Spain beat Argentina 95–75 in the final to become world champions. Australia finished fourth.
